verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec at clickhouse.com/openapi.json, and the changelog documents HTTP-interface behavior such as the X-ClickHouse-Format request header, so the product can be driven programmatically over a public API. The official CLI and MCP server add further documented programmatic surfaces. Missing for 10: in-depth API reference documentation in the pack (endpoints, authentication, Cloud management API scope), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
